statement: The circumcircles of △AA_1A_2, △BB_1B_2, and △CC_1C_2 have exactly two common points.
statement_latex: The circumcircles of $\triangle AA_1A_2$, $\triangle BB_1B_2$, and $\triangle CC_1C_2$ have exactly two common points.
